5.t: to bring the matter to an end,

6.t: on the Day when the blast reverberates

10.t: They say, ‘What? shall we be brought back to life,

11.t: after we have turned into decayed bones?’ and they say,

13.t: But all it will take is a single blast,

14.t: and they will be back above ground.

15.t: Have you [Prophet] heard the story of Moses?

16.t: His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa:

17.t: ‘Go to Pharaoh, for he has exceeded all bounds,

18.t: and ask him, “Do you want to purify yourself [of sin]?

19.t: Do you want me to guide you to your Lord, so that you may hold Him in awe?” ’

20.t: Moses showed him the great sign,

21.t: but he denied it and refused [the faith].

25.t: so God condemned him to punishment in the life to come as well as in this life:

26.t: there truly is a lesson in this for anyone who stands in awe of God.

27.t: Which is harder to create: you people or the sky that He built,

28.t: raising it high and perfecting it,

29.t: giving darkness to its night and bringing out its morning brightness,

30.t: and the earth, too, He spread out,

31.t: bringing waters and pastures out of it,

33.t: for you and your animals to enjoy?

34.t: When the great overwhelming event arrives

35.t: on the Day that man remembers what he has done

36.t: and Hell is there for all to see,

40.t: for anyone who feared the meeting with his Lord and restrained himself from base desires,

42.t: They ask you [Prophet] about the Hour,

43.t: saying, ‘When will it arrive?’, but how can you tell [them that]?

44.t: Its time is known only to your Lord;

45.t: you are only sent to warn those who fear it.

46.t: On the Day they see it, it will seem they lingered [in this life] an evening [at most,] or its morning.
